verdict.rationale: A system-to-system filing channel (system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs) is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing channels: online filing portals, CCFS search, downloadable forms, live chat, and a paid in-person counter. Nothing documents an API, a bulk or batch filer program, or a published enrollment path for software transactors.
